Rae (partnerships): Quick sync  we need a compact dry-run for marketplace publish: HW badge placement, SI activation flow, landing hero freeze, and press embargo choreography. Proposed slot: Tue 09:00 PT. Can we confirm owners?
Noor (marketing): I can own hero + CTAs. Need partner-approved logo svgs (2x) and a one-line quote by Mon COB. Will build a fallback hero if we don't get them.
Ibrahim (eng): Staging infra ready. I'll spin two preview tenants and post URLs. Small smoke script to validate provisioning + meter events: https://git.redwood/repo/rehearsal/smoke.sh
Saanvi (legal): Logo use requires signed asset addendum. I sent the template to partners; if not signed, omit logos/quotes and use neutral copy.
Owen (solutions): SI runbook v1 uploaded: includes SSO steps, seed data, and a failover test. Need a 15m screenshare time during the rehearsal to validate SSO with the SI.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: Tue 07:00 PT -> 07:30 PT. (reaction :rocket:)
Rae (partnerships): Draft run-of-show for Tue 09:00 PT:
- 09:00 - 09:05 goals & owners (Rae)
- 09:05 - 09:20 SI activation + SSO screenshare (Owen/Ibrahim)
- 09:20 - 09:35 Provision + smoke test (Ibrahim)
- 09:35 - 09:45 Hero + asset QA (Noor)
- 09:45 - 09:50 Press embargo sim & takedown (Saanvi)
Please confirm availability.
Noor (marketing): Confirmed. I'll prepare alternate hero and responsive assets.
Ibrahim (eng): Confirmed. Will post preview URLs by Mon AM and run the smoke script.
Owen (solutions): Confirmed. Will bring runbook and demo tenant.
Saanvi (legal): Confirmed. Will simulate embargo leak and takedown steps.
Rae (partnerships): Action items:
- logos + one-line quotes -> owner: Noor / due Mon COB
- signed asset addendum -> owner: Saanvi / due Mon COB
- 2 preview tenants + preview URLs -> owner: Ibrahim / due Mon AM
- SI runbook + screenshare -> owner: Owen / due Mon EOD
- press embargo plan -> owner: Noor / due Tue 07:00 PT
If blockers appear, drop them here or DM me. :sparkles:
